# 3 bedroom detached house for sale

> The Kingley is a new home that embraces all the comings and goings of family life. An en suite bedroom with a dressing area looks after the grown-ups, the open plan kitchen/dining room with French doors takes care of an inside-outside lifestyle, an integral garage keeps the family car under cover and a utility room provides an extra practical space.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bedrooms
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Plot 115, Harrogate
- Cena: £409,950
